survey_flask_app.name: survey_flask_app
survey_flask_app.description: Extracts routes and dataclass models from a Flask application tree.
survey_flask_app.when_to_use: At the start of a Flask-to-anything port, before writing any target code.

tests.test_main.py:
from main import run


def test_run_returns_shape():
    result = run({"path": "."})
    assert "routes" in result
    assert "models" in result

port_flask_route.name: port_flask_route
port_flask_route.description: Translates a single Flask route function into an equivalent Hono handler.
port_flask_route.when_to_use: For each Flask route being ported to a Hono/TypeScript service.

tests.test_main.py:
from main import run


def test_run_returns_file():
    result = run({"route": "GET /profile/<id>"})
    assert result["file"].endswith(".ts")

run_hono_smoke_test.description: Starts a local Hono server and exercises each route once.
run_hono_smoke_test.when_to_use: After porting routes, to check basic end-to-end behavior.

run_hono_smoke_test.name: run_hono_smoke_test
run_hono_smoke_test.description: Starts a local Hono server and exercises each route once, with response-shape assertions.
run_hono_smoke_test.when_to_use: After porting routes, to check both reachability and response-shape parity.

tests.test_main.py:

def test_run_returns_counts():

analyze_dockerfile_layers.name: analyze_dockerfile_layers
analyze_dockerfile_layers.description: Reports per-layer size and a CVE scan summary for a Dockerfile-built image.
analyze_dockerfile_layers.when_to_use: To measure a baseline before optimizing, or to compare against a recorded baseline.

from main import run


def test_run_returns_metrics():
    result = run({"dockerfile": "Dockerfile"})
    assert "size_mb" in result
